status: Source and behavior contract; actual qualification is recorded separately

navigation.preserved: Existing scoped payload Activity collection/rendering remains separate and first. Transfers saved totals and P04-16 counters remain separate.

data_authority.source: Existing immutable P04-16 EngineStatistics packets from an actual owned libtorrent2.0.12 operation
data_authority.time_unit: elapsed steady nanoseconds since first accepted engine observation
data_authority.rate_algorithm: Use six existing exact floor rates; never derive new rates from GUI time, cumulative totals, payload telemetry or saved totals.
data_authority.protocol_rounding: Plot provided protocolReceived/protocolSent fields; subtraction of separately floored combined/payload rates is not the protocol rate.

series.accounting: Combined already includes payload+protocol; three series are not added again.

retention.owner: Window-owned bounded history, independent of the Page lifetime
retention.unknown_rate_observation: Updates latest packet/gap state without adding a rate point. Previous actual points remain available.
retention.same_operation_reopen: Reopening the Page restores the retained points and latest truthful state.
retention.new_identity: Accepted new operation or profile clears prior history. Wrong/stale identity never mutates current history.

connectivity.ordinary_segment: Connect only adjacent retained known-rate Observed points whose source packet sequences are consecutive in the same operation and whose elapsed time increases.
connectivity.first_or_unknown_rate: No point and no invented zero; next known point begins a new segment.
connectivity.known_zero_rate: A real measured zero is retained/plotted.
connectivity.skipped_sequence: A coalesced or otherwise skipped sequence breaks connectivity; it does not imply zero, constant traffic or missing reconstructed samples.
connectivity.terminal_equal_or_omitted_sample: Same operation repeated last sample adds no point; terminal state remains visible.
connectivity.terminal_newer_actual_sample: At most one actual newer-time rate point, always standalone, never connected to preceding observation.
connectivity.after_terminal: No extrapolated tail, synthetic completion point or later same-operation revival.

rendering.x_axis: Actual elapsed-time differences; no index-as-seconds or inserted timestamps.
rendering.y_axis: Nonnegative measured rate values; drawing-coordinate scaling is not a new data observation.
rendering.isolated_point: Visible as a point, including zero or standalone terminal point.
rendering.latest_unknown: Latest six rate labels say unavailable when latest rates are absent, even while older graph points remain.
rendering.no_background_animation: No graph sampling/render timer or added threads; hidden/minimized views defer painting without manufacturing observations.
rendering.scope_notice: One experimental transfer-engine operation; last observed traffic, not global/lifetime history or exhaustive final totals.

lifecycle.page_close: Closes only the view; does not cancel transfer, reset the operation or discard Window history.
lifecycle.saved_refresh: Does not reset engine history or request an engine sample.

qualification.new_graph_execution_status: See published milestone evidence for executed source hashes and results
